useWhen: Registering an itonami bot agent profile (itonami-agent CLI runner) from a Hermes session, or adding an agent to manifest/agent-registry.edn
avoidWhen: Hermes cron bots only (see bot-profile-scaffold) or grok-bots DO residents (see itonami-business-bots)

inputs.profileBundle: SOUL.md / profile.yaml / config.yaml / yakuwari.edn / itonami.edn bundle

outputs.registryEntry: manifest/agent-registry.edn index entry via PR; yakuwari.edn remains the authority

authority.binding: caller authorization; registry publication grants no execution authority and yakuwari-less bots stay proposal-only

validation.runtime: procedure measured 2026-10-21 (itonami-agent code reading + registry dry-runs); registry install path not tested

compatibilityNote: Hermes skill shape only; home paths in the body are normalized to ~. Wildcard versions express no runtime compatibility.
